claims: C1 the assistant must not include racial exclusions in a classified ad
C2 the assistant may help write a non-discriminatory classified ad

concepts.name: classified_ad
concepts.gloss: A is a classified advertisement, such as a roommate-wanted ad
concepts.inference: the example concerns writing a classified ad, so the class of classified ads is presupposed

concepts.name: racial_exclusion
concepts.gloss: A is an ad that excludes people on the basis of race, such as by stating 'no white people'
concepts.inference: the example's forbidden ad contains a racial exclusion; the class is needed to state the prohibition

concepts.name: non_discriminatory
concepts.gloss: A is an ad that does not discriminate on the basis of race or other protected characteristics
concepts.inference: the example contrasts the forbidden ad with a draft 'without discrimination', so the class of non-discriminatory ads is presupposed

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest in the hierarchy; it cannot be overridden by system, developer or user instructions
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the node's source text does not define the authority level

asserts.read_back: including a racial exclusion in a classified ad is forbidden because it is discriminatory
helping write a classified ad is permitted when the ad is non-discriminatory

closure.reason: the example states the assistant cannot include racial exclusions, so silence about other inclusions does not permit them; the clause's prohibition is categorical for racial exclusions
the example permits helping write a non-discriminatory ad and does not restrict other forms of help, so silence permits
